name: c5_frozen
data: PTB-XL, labels MI vs NORM as in py/a3_ptbxl.py labels(); folds train 1-8, validate 9, test 10; windows from py/c5_windows.py (median beat per lead, same int8 pre-processing as C1, causal 0.5 Hz high-pass)
model: beatnet-tiny (same architecture as C2), one network per lead, 3 seeds (0,1,2; job seed = 100*lead_index + seed)
epoch_sampling: all MI + equal number of NORM per epoch
early_stopping: AUPRC on fold 9, patience 5, restore best
lead_selection: highest mean (over seeds) fold-9 AUROC; chosen lead written to this file (chosen_lead) before fold 10 is scored
threshold: Youden point on fold 9 for the sensitivity/specificity rows (float seed 0); INT8 uses the threshold giving the same positive fraction on fold 9
comparators: A3 frozen logistic models (configs/a3_frozen.json) re-fit on folds 1-8 and scored on fold 10 with patient-level bootstrap: ST only, all five, heart rate only, per lead (zero-phase filtering as in A3)
int8: post-training INT8 of the chosen lead's seed-0 model, py/c3_quantize.quantize (per-tensor), calibration on 4000 training-fold windows
